items.title: Gold price per tola increases Rs4,700 in Pakistan
items.summary:
Gold prices in Pakistan increased on Thursday in line with their gain in the international market. In the local market, gold price per tola reached Rs378,636 after a gain of Rs4,700 during the day.
Similarly, 10-gram gold was sold at 324,619 after it increased by Rs4,030, according to rates shared by the All-Pakistan Gems and Jewellers Sarafa Association (APGJSA).
